all: Every class can learn every weapon skill and wear every kind of armor (mail and plate from level 40, shields come with Block). Weapon masters teach every weapon and Dual Wield. A new ranged weapon comes with an attack to use it.

Right-click an enemy out of melee range while holding a bow, gun, crossbow, thrown weapon or wand to start shooting it. When the enemy comes into melee range you switch to melee, and back to shooting when it leaves (.rangedauto changes this).
Nobody needs ammo: every player has Requires No Ammo.
Parachute is taught by every class trainer from level 10. Its cooldown gets shorter as you level: 10 min at 10, then 8, 6, 5, 4, 3 and 2.5 min, down to 2 min at 80.
Party-wide class auras, shouts, totems and party buffs reach your whole raid. Healing spells are not changed.
Friendly class buffs that lasted 10 or 30 minutes now last 1 hour.

Class spells that need reagents (portals, Arcane Brilliance, Greater Blessings, Gift of the Wild, Prayer of Fortitude, warlock stones and summons, Rebirth, Reincarnation and more) are free unless you choose to use reagents with .reagents on.
Spell tooltips still show the old numbers for many of these changes. The cooldown bar and buff timers show the real ones.
Class spells can be learned automatically when you level up (turn it on from the spellbook, .autolearn, or at a class trainer).
Creatures hitting you from behind no longer daze you or knock you off your mount.
Every racial is stronger and its cooldown is 25% shorter (at most 2 min, not below 45 sec). Shadowmeld and Escape Artist have a 1 min cooldown.
Every race has its own racial heal (a 10 sec channel that heals 7% health every 2 sec, 2 min cooldown). Undead keep Cannibalize.
Racial Sword, Mace and Axe Specialization give +1% critical strike chance and 1% less chance to be dodged or parried with those weapons.
Heritage lets you take another race's racial traits (from level 10, 10 gold, once a day), plus one extra racial from a race that can't be played.
Classes that use mana know Slap: it wakes a sleeping player, friend or foe. An enemy also takes your basic attack.

You also know a Steady copy of your crowd control (Polymorph, Entangling Roots, Hibernate, Sap, Gouge, Blind, Repentance, Hex, Shackle Undead, Scatter Shot) that damage doesn't break. It shares the cooldown and diminishing returns of the usual spell.

Everyone can revive: every class has a slow out of combat Resurrection (60 sec cast, 20% health, 10% mana), and First Aid 150 gives Resuscitate. Healer specs get a mass revive, and tank and healer specs a combat revive (10 min cooldown).

In dungeons and raids, combat revives share the group's battle resurrection charges: raids start with 3 and get 1 more every 10 min, dungeons start with 1 and get 1 more every 15 min. .battleres shows them.
Tank specs make 50% more threat in their tanking stance, form or presence. Healer specs make 30% less threat. .threat shows what applies to you.

Group tank places: 1 tank in a party, 2 in a raid of up to 10, 3 in a bigger raid. With too many tanks the group chooses who tanks; with no tank someone can stand in as Stand-in Tank. Taking the tank role in the Dungeon Finder without a tank spec gives Not Playing Your Spec.

Pets that tank (hunter pets with Growl, the Voidwalker, the Felguard and the Greater Earth Elemental) make 100% more threat and get 2% of their health and power back every second out of combat (.pettank).

1: Victory Rush is learned at level 10.
Protection warriors make 50% more threat in Defensive Stance.
Heroic Leap is taught by warrior trainers at level 40.
Lingering Rage (talent): after combat your rage waits 2 sec per rank before it starts to fade.
2: Protection paladins make 50% more threat with Righteous Fury. Holy paladins make 30% less threat.
Judgement of Light that would heal someone at full health gives them Light's Reserve instead: their next Judgement of Light heal is 5% bigger per stack (up to 20 stacks).
Overwhelming Light (Holy paladins): Holy Light, Flash of Light or Holy Shock healing someone to full also heals up to 3 injured group members within 10 yards of them for 10% of the heal.
Templar's Bulwark (talent): the shield absorbs damage equal to your maximum health.
Light's Vigil (talent): Holy Shock on a target with your vigil has no cooldown and also heals the target's party members within 30 yards.
3: Your pet is always happy, so it never needs feeding.
Mend Pet heals 50% more for half the mana. Pets with Growl make 100% more threat.
Survival hunters can turn on tank mode (.tankmode): more threat, Taunt, 10% less damage taken, and Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite make double threat.
Call of the Pack is taught by hunter trainers at level 40.
Lone Wolf (talent): 20% more damage while you have no pet out. Focused Fire (talent): 1% or 2% more damage while your pet is out.
4: Combo points are kept when you change target: selecting another enemy moves them onto it, and they stay when their target dies (forgotten after 20 sec out of combat).
Every tick of your bleeds (Rupture, Garrote, bleeding weapons) adds 1 sec to your Slice and Dice, up to its full length.

Rogues can learn disguises: from level 2 your trainer teaches one, and disguise contacts in the world teach others. While disguised, that group takes you for one of their own until you fight or cast a hostile spell (.disguise).
Redirect is taught by rogue trainers at level 42: it moves your combo points to your new target.
Combat rogues can turn on tank mode (.tankmode): more threat, Taunt, 10% less damage taken, and Sinister Strike makes double threat.
5: Night elf priests can use bows (they know Bows and Shoot) and learn Elune's Arrow from level 20 while holding a bow.
Discipline priests learn Power Word: Barrier at level 60.
Discipline and Holy priests make 30% less threat.
Holy Fire hits 10% harder, and its burn lasts 16 sec and deals 40% more in total.
Lightwell has 15 charges, and each player can drink from a Lightwell only once.
6: Death knights of every spec make 50% more threat in Frost Presence.
7: Totemic Recall is trained at level 10 for 10 silver.
Ghost Wolf walks on water once you know Water Walking.
Sentry Totem reveals stealthed and invisible enemies within 10 yards.
Rolling Thunder: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning hits while Lightning Shield is up have a 60% chance to give back 2% of your maximum mana and add a Lightning Shield charge (up to 9).
Shamans learn Stonewall Slam at level 20: a short range taunt used with a shield.
Enhancement shamans can turn on tank mode (.tankmode): more threat, Taunt, 10% less damage taken, and Earth Shock makes triple threat. The Greater Earth Elemental makes 100% more threat.
8: Mages learn Overloaded Blast from level 32: when one of your spells is fully or partly resisted you are Overloaded for 5 sec, and Overloaded Blast can be used then. It can't be resisted.
Rune of Power is taught by mage trainers at level 50.
9: Soul Shards stack to 99 with no limit on how many you carry. Infernal Stone costs 10 silver and Demonic Figurine 20 silver, and both fit in soul bags.
An equipped soul bag may give back the Soul Shard, Infernal Stone or Demonic Figurine a spell used: 5% for a 16 slot bag up to 25% for a 32 slot bag.
Ritual of Doom needs the warlock and 2 helpers, and no one is sacrificed.
Affliction warlocks feed the group: every tick of your damage over time heals group members within 40 yards for 2% of the damage and gives them 1% of it as mana (alone, it feeds you).

The price of curses: in a group, cursing an enemy with Curse of Weakness, Recklessness, Tongues, the Elements or Exhaustion puts a copy of that curse on you at 25% strength for up to 30 sec. Malediction takes the price away.
Curse of Agony, Doom, Tongues and Exhaustion are banes: you can keep one bane and one other curse on the same target.
Demonic Empowerment also empowers an Infernal, a Doomguard and an enslaved demon.
Health Funnel heals 50% more for half the health. The Voidwalker and Felguard make 100% more threat.
Warlocks have a soulstone revive: instant, 40 yards, 30 sec cooldown, costs 40% of your maximum mana.
Demonology warlocks can turn on tank mode (.tankmode): more threat, Taunt, 10% less damage taken, and Hellfire makes double threat while Shadow Bolt, Searing Pain and Drain Soul make 50% more.
Create Healthstone, Inferno and Soulshatter use a Soul Shard again (free with reagents off).

Talents: Demonic Energies heals your pet for 4% (8% at rank 2) of your damage and Life Tap also gives it mana; Bane of Havoc sends 15% of your damage to the target with your bane; Demonic Brand makes your pet hit the branded target 10/20/30% harder.
11: Tranquility heals the 5 most injured raid members in reach, not only your party.
Feral druids make 50% more threat in Bear or Dire Bear Form. Restoration druids make 30% less threat.
Wildkin Frenzy: taking a hit in Moonkin Form gives +5% spell damage, +10% attack power and no spell pushback for 8 sec.
Tiger's Fury lasts 18 sec, and every bleed tick during it stacks Tiger's Bloodlust (+1% physical damage, up to 10), lost when Tiger's Fury ends.
Cat Form combo points are kept when you change target, like a rogue's.
At a flight master in Flight Form you can fly in Flight Form for half the fare, and you are back in Flight Form when you land.
Bloom (talent): Rejuvenation or Regrowth running out heals the target for 100% of your Spirit (50% when dispelled). Predatory Discipline (talent): Ferocious Bite gives back the extra energy it used.
